prompt:
Hi — I'm Maria Chen from Greenhouse Operations. We've just received three new seed lots (L2024-010 tomato, L2024-011 lettuce, L2024-012 pepper) and I need a formal audit report before we commit to our spring planting calendar.

For each lot I have an observed germination percentage and a target transplant date (see seed_inventory/lot_2024/assessment_request.json). I need you to produce a file called seed_lot_audit.json that covers:

1. Whether each lot meets the accepted commercial viability standard for its crop type.
2. The recommended sow date for each lot, working backwards from the target transplant date to account for the full grow-out period.
3. The expected benchmark germination range for each crop so we can see at a glance how our observed rates compare.

Please use the germination reference tools available in the workspace to look up the correct standards, thresholds, and scheduling formulas — don't rely on guesswork. The purchasing team will use this report to decide whether to re-order any lots.
